item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=causal+state+predictive+sufficiency+coarse+graining+thermodynamics&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1017/9781009024358.018\", \"title\": [\"Coarse-Graining\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1017/9781009024358.018\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025, 6, 30]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7197564\", \"title\": [\"Decoherence, Epistemic Coarse-Graining, and the Emergence of Classical Causal Structure\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>This paper demonstrates that classical causal structures necessarily emerge from the quantum formalism under the resource constraints of finite agents. Rather than interpreting decoherence as an objective physical collapse, this paper formalizes the partial trace operation as a minimal-entropy-increase completely positive and trace-preserving (CPTP) coarse-graining map, E = Tr ε , whose entropy increase ∆S and trace distance bound D ≤ O(e-t/τ D) quantify the epistemic horizon. The Kochen-Specker and Bell theorems falsify the existence of a global Kolmogorov joint probability and Reichenbach's Common Cause Principle at the pure quantum level, leaving Pearl's do-calculus undefined in the undecohered algebra A SE. By integrating the quantum Darwinism redundancy R δ ≫ 1 and the decoherent histories functional D(⃗ α, ⃗ β) = O(ε), this paper constructively proves that the approximate pointer algebra A p satisfies approximate Markovianity and modularity within an O(ε + δ) error bound, thereby establishing an effective do-operation that satisfies Pearl's truncated factorization formula. The causal asymmetry thus originates from the irreversibility of E rather than the time arrow of the Hamiltonian. Macroscopic causality is shown to be an effective topology necessarily adopted by finite agents to maintain Dutchbook consistency in empirical predictions.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7197564\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1103/physreve.85.041125\", \"title\": [\"Stochastic thermodynamics under coarse graining\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1103/physreve.85.041125\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2012, 4, 17]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.3390/e22050525\", \"title\": [\"Thermodynamics of the Coarse-Graining Maste…
